    meeting_end = convert_to_datetime(meeting['end'])

    travel_time = travel_times[(current_location, meeting['location'])]

                'start_time': start.strftime('%H:%M'),
                'end_time': end.strftime('%H:%M')
            })
            current_time = end
            current_location = meeting['location']
    
    return itinerary

}
